_comment: Provenance for the 2 schemes of github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-fmm-records, imported from Perminov's JSON mirror (schemes/known/arhancanli) by UpstreamSchemeRepos.CANLI on 2026-11-24, audited 2026-11-25. Files are RE-ENCODED in the catalog's canonical format (coefficients unchanged).
discovery_note: Arhan Canli, Quantavane FMM records, github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-fmm-records (2026-11) — read from Andrew Perminov's mirror (FastMatrixMultiplication schemes/known/arhancanli, 2026-11-16). Non-commutative scheme over ℚ. Audit 2026-11-25: ⟨9,10,11⟩ 640 (this catalog, Perminov and FMM-Lille held 644) and ⟨9,11,11⟩ 708 (710, Cloudroom Math 2026); FMM-Lille took up 708 on 2026-11-15 (per Sidebottom's README) and lists 640, Perminov's status.json carries both. ⟨9,11,11⟩ has since been lowered to 705 (Sidebottom 2026, 2026-11-20) and 702 (He 2026, 2026-11-24); 640 stands. Upper bounds.
notes: Re-encoded from Perminov's JSON mirror of the author's Maple tensors into the catalog's canonical format — no coefficient was changed. Credit Arhan Canli. The origin repository's intermediate schemes (641, 642, 643 for ⟨9,10,11⟩; 709 for ⟨9,11,11⟩) are not mirrored and not imported.
